title: CAN MACHINES THINK LIKE HUMANS? A BEHAVIORAL EVALUATION OF LLM AGENTS IN DICTATOR GAMES
reasoning: The paper provides an in-depth behavioral evaluation of LLMs focusing on prosocial behavior, fairness, and altruism, which are core ethical concepts. It specifically explores how AI agents align with human ethical norms and values in decision-making scenarios, including an analysis of psychological processes that explicitly measures linguistic markers for religion, compassion, and empathy.
